title: Finishing a complete giraffe genome from telomere to telomere with Verkko-Fillet.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Zenodo API file listings: record 19867517 holds one 29.9 MB zip of the giraffeT2T annotation GitHub repo (CC-BY-4.0); record 19868173 holds one 1.47 GB gzipped FASTA (HG002 human diploid assembly). Did not download or open either file.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Raw reads and giraffe assemblies under BioProject PRJNA1322564; RefSeq annotation GCF_054371585.1; quality values Q61.5 to Q73.6; the software tool is on GitHub (marbl/verkko-fillet). Supplement listing timed out and was not retrieved.

a1_downloadable.note: Zenodo records are public, CC-BY-4.0 (checked listing); NCBI BioProject is public per paper.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No labelled table exists. The outputs are one finished giraffe genome, one human genome, and annotation files; any prediction target (e.g. assembly error, gap location) would have to be constructed by the user.

a3_inputs_present.note: Sequences are present as FASTA (per listing/paper), not just accessions.

a4_units_stated.note: Not applicable; no measured quantity table.

a5_enough_rows.note: Effectively n = 1 genome (plus HG002); no set of labelled examples.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~1.5 GB per assembly FASTA; raw reads far larger
a6_fits_laptop.note: A single assembly fits, but raw long reads (needed for any curation-error task) do not.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any candidate label (curated edit vs. not) would come from this tool's own manual curation of one genome, not an independent measurement.

honest_claim_h3: No model claim is supportable: the data is a single genome assembly with no labelled examples.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use assembly-graph features around regions of a draft genome to predict where manual curation will be needed.
plain_idea.train_on: Regions of one giraffe draft assembly graph and the curator's edits; number of edited regions unknown (likely tens).
plain_idea.predict: Whether a region needed a manual fix, taken from the curation log of this one genome, not an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Genome assembly teams could triage curation effort, but one genome's edits are far too few to train or test such a model.

ml_idea: None viable: a tool-and-resource paper producing one telomere-to-telomere giraffe genome; no labelled dataset for supervised learning.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; project rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count curated edits in the giraffeT2T repo; already fails on lack of a label table.

verdict_reason: Genome-assembly software paper yielding one finished giraffe genome; no label column and effectively n=1 (fails A2, A5, A8).
